name: open-ecdh-p256-off-curve
description: docs/spec--sealed-key-envelopes.md sections 4 and 6 require a valid P-256 point and generic unseal_failed refusal. This 97-octet envelope retains the historical off-curve point and public test recipient scalar. Its ciphertext/tag were independently rebuilt with test-only nonvalidating scalar multiplication, raw 32-octet x as AES-256-GCM key, zero nonce and the recorded BIND. The deliberately lax control authenticates and recovers the recorded 16-octet content key; strict WebCrypto refuses the peer point. Changing BIND fails authentication. The independent producer/control is documented in verification/vectors/README.md; no production or primitive-conformance implementation uses its arithmetic.

nonvalidatingControl.method: Test-only affine multiplication over the P-256 prime with a=-3, deliberately omitting the curve equation; not a protocol input or production algorithm.
